items.title: NixOS 26.11 – Release schedule

labels.name: 6.topic: release process
labels.description: Issues or PRs which are parts of the NixOS release process

items.body:
Hi, we are @Scrumplex and @yayayayaka, the [release managers](https://nixos.github.io/release-wiki/Release-Managers.html) for NixOS 26.11 ("Zokor"). We are also happy to work with @NotAShelf and @coolcuber, who will be the [release editors](https://nixos.github.io/release-wiki/Release-Editors.html) for this NixOS release. Below you can find the release calendar up to the planned release at the end of November 2026. If something feels unclear to you, don't hesitate to reach out, we appreciate questions, feedback and suggestions. We are here to guide the process and make sure this will be a great release for all of us. You can contact us in the [release management matrix room](https://matrix.to/#/#nixos-release-management:nixos.org). These dates may still change slightly. The decision on how many staging cycles will happen will be made later. When a step is done, it will be announced under this issue or with a separate GitHub issue or [discourse](https://discourse.nixos.org/) post.
Done? Date (UTC) Branches Affected Events
✅ #567960 2026-09-28 Start discussion about “Feature Freeze & Release Blockers” with ecosystems maintainers
✅ 2026-10-12 08:00 All branches Restrict breaking changes to Release Critical Packages
✅ 2026-10-26 08:00 All branches Restrict all breaking changes with the exception of updates to desktop environment
2026-11-02 2026-11-07 08:00 master Wait for staging-next merge into master, begin first staging-next cycle
master Begin Zero Hydra Failures campaign
2026-11-09 2026-11-14 08:00 master Wait for first staging-next merge into master; begin second staging-next cycle
staging, staging-26.11 Perform staging branch-off
staging Unrestrict all breaking changes; new changes will not be present in the release
2026-11-16 2026-11-23 08:00 master Wait for second staging-next merge into master
staging-next Unrestrict all breaking changes; new changes will not be present in the release
master, release-26.11 Perform Branch-off, create release channels, create new beta / unstable tags
master Mark failing packages as broken
master, release-26.11 Create the release branch and tags
release-26.11 Create release channels
master, release-26.11 Fixes need to use the “backport” workflow to arrive in the release
master Unrestrict all breaking changes; new changes will not be present in the release
release-26.11 Prepare for release, finish remaining issues
2026-11-23 2026-11-30 08:00 release-26.11 Release! Marks the end of the Zero Hydra Failures campaign.
2026-11-30 2026-12-06 Release Retrospective, everyone is invited to give feedback!
2027-01-04 2027-01-11 End of life cleanup
